_readme.what: PLACEHOLDER DATA for design review of the 'create your own bowl' INTERACTION only. It is NOT the club's menu: every option name and every price below is invented on purpose (Base 1, Protein A, ...). It is loaded by assets/js/nutrition.js only when the page URL carries ?demo=bowl, replaces menu.json's bowl for that view, and shows the banner below on the component. It is never the default and must never be linked from the page.
_readme.shape: Same shape as menu.json's `bowl` (documented at the top of assets/js/nutrition.js), plus `demo` (true), `banner` (visible banner text) and `previewLabel` (shown instead of opening WhatsApp, so a review click never sends a message to the club).
_readme.toReplace: When the club's real bowl steps and prices are known, put them into menu.json under `bowl` with priceUnitConfirmed true. No code change. This file can then be deleted.
